name: harper-grammar-coach-devtests
description: Development-only harness for the renderer half (desktop/plugin.js). The shipped plugin installs NO JavaScript: it imports only @hermes/plugin-sdk and react, both supplied by the Hermes renderer. These devDependencies exist so `npm test` can load the real plugin module under node:test with a stub SDK, and so one interaction test can render it in jsdom.
